select a.user_id as user_id,nvl(b.miss,0) as miss,nvl(c.take,0) as take,nvl(d.refuse,0) as refuse from (select user_id from OHT_CASE_TASK where to_char((TO_DATE('19700101','yyyymmdd') + data_time/86400 +TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TZ_OFFSET(sessiontimezone),1,3))/24),'yyyy-MM-dd') between #{begDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by user_id ) a left join (select user_id,count(task_status) as miss from OHT_CASE_TASK where task_status=0 and to_char((TO_DATE('19700101','yyyymmdd') + data_time/86400 +TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TZ_OFFSET(sessiontimezone),1,3))/24),'yyyy-MM-dd') between #{begDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by user_id) b on (a.user_id = b.user_id) left join (select user_id,count(task_status) as take from OHT_CASE_TASK where task_status=1 and to_char((TO_DATE('19700101','yyyymmdd') + data_time/86400 +TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TZ_OFFSET(sessiontimezone),1,3))/24),'yyyy-MM-dd') between #{begDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by user_id) c on (a.user_id = c.user_id) left join (select user_id,count(task_status) as refuse from OHT_CASE_TASK where task_status=2 and to_char((TO_DATE('19700101','yyyymmdd') + data_time/86400 +TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TZ_OFFSET(sessiontimezone),1,3))/24),'yyyy-MM-dd') between #{begDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by user_id) d on (a.user_id = d.user_id)
